title: ADTRIBE - We help eCommerce businesses to grow profitably

facts.fact: ADTRIBE states that its agency charges no setup fees and requires no long-term contracts.
facts.value: no setup fees; no long-term contracts
facts.quote: Our agency deliver no setup fees, no long-term contracts, and data-driven results

facts.fact: ADTRIBE says it can typically start a client's campaign within two weeks after the client makes contact.
facts.quote: Once you contact us, we can typically start your campaign within two weeks

facts.fact: ADTRIBE offers a free strategy session that clients can book to receive a tailored growth plan.
facts.quote: Click here to schedule a free strategy session today.

facts.fact: ADTRIBE includes a comprehensive first 30-day launch plan for new clients.
ADTRIBE states its services include paid social, PPC, email marketing, conversion rate optimization, and data analytics.
facts.quote: We offer comprehensive services including paid social, PPC, email marketing, conversion rate optimization, and data analytics

facts.fact: ADTRIBE describes itself as helping ecommerce brands accelerate growth through advertising and retention marketing.
facts.quote: We help ecommerce brands accelerate growth through world-class advertising and retention marketing.

facts.fact: ADTRIBE says it will survey a client's team and research the client's competitors as part of onboarding.
facts.quote: We’ll survey your team & research your competitors

facts.fact: ADTRIBE says each client gets a dedicated account strategist who oversees the client's brand directly.
facts.quote: No secrets. Talk directly to the person overseeing your brand.
